verdict.rationale: Stark Bank is a regulated banking platform exposed through a REST API and SDKs, not an AI agent or assistant that would act as an MCP client. Plugging in MCP servers for the product to use their tools is therefore a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows Stark Bank shipping any agent or MCP-client capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
